_comment: Guideline clock lengths for Cycle Extract sub-periods. Draft values - not the official HPT guideline.
_defrost_indicator_columns: Optional list of column names in the Plotdaten sheet that flag an active defrost. Leave empty when the export has none; kind then comes from the stored cycle_type or the analyst dropdown.
_dt_hp_comment: dT_HP = T_supply (Ts Buh when present) - T_return_emu; this is not dTreturn. A defrost happened when dT_HP stays below dt_hp_recover_k for dt_hp_hold_s (the cold-side test). The hold is a tool choice so a one-sample flicker does not count as a defrost.
_dt_hp_recovery_hold_comment: The defrost termination watch: after the upward crossing of dt_hp_recover_k, dT_HP must stay at or above it for dt_hp_recovery_hold_s. A dip below cancels that crossing; the last crossing that passes is the termination and the stored time is the crossing itself. dt_hp_hold_s stays the cold-side test (dT_HP below the threshold for that long means a defrost happened).
